name: i.safe MOBILE IS945.1
summary: The i.safe MOBILE IS945.1 is an intrinsically safe (Ex ib) 10.1-inch Windows tablet from i.safe MOBILE, certified for Zone 1/21 under ATEX and IECEx. It runs Windows 11 IoT Enterprise LTSC for Arm64.

otherSchemes: IA South Africa, PCEC China, INMETRO, Japan-Ex, KCs

atex.marking: II 2G Ex ib IIC T4 Gb / II 2D Ex ib IIIC T135°C Db
atex.status: IECEx Current, issue 1 (2025-02-06), checked 2026-10-25 (same certificate as IS-940.1).

iecex.marking: Ex ib IIC T4 Gb / Ex ib IIIC T135°C Db

certification.northAmerica: NEC 500 (QPS LR3081-7, 2025-08-13): Class I Div 1 Groups A, B, C, D T4; Class II Div 1 Groups E, F, G 155 °C; Class III; IP64; −20 °C to +55 °C

safety.conditions: Battery may be replaced outside explosion hazardous areas only; protect against excessive UV light and high electrostatic charge; USB-C interface under IP cover may only be opened outside hazardous areas; 16-pin ISM interface must be closed with its cover when not in use in hazardous areas; ambient −20 °C to +55 °C; charging temperature limited to 0 °C to +45 °C (IECEx EPS 24.0001X issue 1). Safety instructions: protect from high-energy impacts; zones 1, 2, 21, 22 only. (certificate shared with IS-940.1; Windows safety instructions not read)
safety.peripherals: Same as IS-940.1: covers closed; in Ex areas only the approved 16-pin ISM accessories (IS-HS2A.1, IS-RSM3A.1, IS-PTTB1A.1, IS-HDHS1x.1), dock on 12-pin, nano-SIM and approved microSD.
safety.certifiedAccessories: As IS-940.1 (headsets, PTT button, remote speaker microphone, IS-DS940.1 dock, multi charger, leather cases, vehicle mount).

strengths: May be charged inside the hazardous area, within the certificate's limits
ATEX and IECEx certified, with published certificate numbers
Also certified for Class I Division 1 in North America
A mining version (Group I) is also available
limitations: T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
Windows on Arm: x86/x64 apps run through emulation and need Arm64 drivers
